_doc: LOOKS = pack (layout family: noir dark / atelier light) + theme (palette, accent font, atmosphere) + backdrop (moving background). Choose by the story's feeling, and never the same theme as the previous two episodes in history/STORIES.md. Visual menu: engine/gallery/looks.jpg (./sv looks).

noir.smoke: drifting coloured smoke under a moving glow — the default dark atmosphere
noir.rays: soft light beams falling from above through haze — sacred, royal, revelations
noir.mist: low fog rolling along the floor — the sea, graveyards, moors, anything cold or lost
noir.void: almost nothing: a deep glow and heavy vignette — records, facts, restraint, the true-story voice

atelier.grid: paper with a drafting grid — explanations, lists, how things work
atelier.plain: warm paper and window light only — tender, intimate stories
atelier.lines: ruled notebook paper — diaries, letters, memories, lessons

ember.label: Ember — black & blood red, electric yellow words
ember.use: horror, murder, curses, gothic tales, anything with fire or blood

abyss.label: Abyss — midnight blue, ice-cyan words
abyss.use: the sea, drowning, ghosts, winter, isolation, space, cold cases

venom.label: Venom — toxic green, acid-lime words, magenta shocks
venom.use: plague, poison, witches, rot, experiments, forbidden science

gilded.label: Gilded — black & gold, elegant serif words
gilded.use: greed, kings and empires, treasure, deals with the devil, luxury gone wrong

bone.label: Bone — ash & sepia archive, pale-amber words, classic serif
bone.use: history, war, true records, old photographs, unsolved mysteries told as fact

violet.label: Violet — night purple, orchid words
violet.use: dreams, the supernatural, madness, tragic love, fairy-tale darkness

paper.label: Paper — grey editorial paper, black words, red accent

cream.label: Cream — warm cream, brown serif words, burnt orange
cream.use: family, childhood, food, nostalgia, gentle parables

sage.label: Sage — soft green paper, forest words

blush.label: Blush — rose paper, wine serif words

slate.label: Slate — cool blue-grey paper, condensed navy words, orange
